issues.description: Element: Bookstore.books property. In solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift the property is declared as 'private let books: [Book]' (line 11). In solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift the Client implementation (in a different file) reads 'bookstore.books' (line 10). The problem statement requires a Bookstore that 'holds an array of Books named books' and expects the Client to iterate the bookstore's inventory. Declaring the property private prevents access from Client in a different file and causes a compilation error, blocking the intended usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the books property at least internal (remove the 'private' modifier) or provide a read-only accessor that Client can use (e.g. internal let books: [Book] or public private(set) var books: [Book]). This preserves immutability while allowing Client to read the inventory.
